{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for customers who converted
df_converted = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute the mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = df_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Also compute the count of converted customers
count_converted = len(df_converted)

mean_age_converted, count_converted"}
